proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not establish which saved notes are included when no explicit selection or filter is supplied.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Two implementers can reasonably produce commands that export different note sets from the same saved-note state.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Export scope determines the command's core behavior and can cause missing or unexpectedly disclosed note content.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Create multiple saved notes with differing states, invoke the command without a selection, and compare the exported set with the stated requirement.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves ambiguous what preserving existing note content means for whitespace, line breaks, markup, Unicode, metadata, and ordering.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: An exported note differs from its stored representation even though no content-changing operation was requested.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Silent normalization or omission can corrupt user-authored information and defeat the preservation constraint.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Save a note containing significant whitespace, multiline text, markup-like characters, Unicode, and metadata; export it and compare every required field and character.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The new compact command conflicts with an existing command, alias, argument, or parsing rule.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: An input that previously triggered one behavior now exports notes, or the export command is interpreted as an older operation.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The change can break established workflows and make the new behavior inaccessible or unsafe.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run the proposed command and all preexisting commands or aliases with overlapping prefixes and argument shapes; observe which action each invokes.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not define whether export output is displayed, streamed, or written to a destination, nor what happens when that destination already contains data.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: The same invocation can reasonably overwrite a file, append to it, emit to standard output, or stop for confirmation.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Destination ambiguity creates data-loss risk and prevents dependable scripting.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Invoke export with no destination, with a new destination, and with an existing nonempty destination; compare the observed outputs and mutations with the requirement.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Behavior is unspecified when there are no saved notes or when a requested subset matches none.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: The command alternately succeeds with empty output, reports an error, or creates an empty artifact depending on implementation.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Exit behavior and artifact creation affect both user understanding and automation reliability.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Invoke export against an empty store and against a filter with zero matches; record output, exit status, and created artifacts.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The synthesized requirements name an export capability without fixing the externally observable output structure and escaping rules.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Independent implementations produce incompatible representations of the same notes.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Consumers cannot reliably read or reuse exports without a stable format contract.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export notes containing delimiters, quotes, embedded newlines, and empty fields; determine whether one unambiguous expected representation follows from the handoff.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The synthesized handoff omits the required order of notes and of any fields within each exported note.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Repeated exports of unchanged data differ in order, or implementations choose creation order, update order, title order, or storage order independently.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Unstable ordering produces noisy diffs and can make output-dependent workflows nondeterministic.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Save notes whose creation, modification, and lexical orders differ; export repeatedly and compare sequence stability with the stated contract.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not enumerate existing note operations and outputs that must remain unchanged after adding export.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Saving, reading, listing, or editing notes changes behavior even though the export command is not invoked.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The requested addition can regress established behavior outside its intended scope.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Capture observable results of existing note commands before the change, repeat them after the change without invoking export, and compare results.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Executing export mutates saved notes, their metadata, their order, or their persisted representation.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: A read, list, checksum, or later export shows changed note state immediately after export.
proposed_lenses.why_material: An export operation that alters its source violates the preservation goal and can cause irreversible user-visible changes.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Snapshot all stored note content and metadata, invoke export, then compare the complete saved-note state with the snapshot.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: A failure during export leaves a destination that appears complete but contains only part of the requested notes.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: After an induced write or serialization failure, a normal-looking export artifact remains with missing or truncated content.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Users or downstream consumers may trust an incomplete export as a valid backup or transfer.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Induce failure after some notes have been emitted and inspect artifact presence, contents, command output, and exit status.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Verification covers ordinary notes but not content that can be misparsed, truncated, transformed, or interpreted as control data.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Notes with boundary-size text, embedded separators, null-like values, terminal control characters, or unusual Unicode fail round-trip comparison while simple notes pass.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Real note content can expose preservation defects hidden by happy-path examples.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export a corpus containing empty, very large, delimiter-heavy, control-character, bidirectional, and non-BMP Unicode notes; compare required content exactly.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Post-implementation findings reveal that consumers interpret the export differently, but the handoff record does not identify which original ambiguity or assumption caused the mismatch.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: A reported export defect cannot be traced to a stated requirement, decision, or explicit unknown in the handoff.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Without observable traceability, recurring ambiguity cannot be distinguished from implementation error, and later revisions may repeat the same failure.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Take a representative post-implementation export complaint and attempt to map it to a specific handoff statement, acceptance condition, or documented unresolved question.

input.acceptance_rule: distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, solution-neutral

rejected_lenses.reason: Rejected as an overbroad regression umbrella. Its concrete command-routing case is already covered by interaction-command-collision; the remaining claim does not identify a distinct failure mode.
Merged into discovery-content-fidelity and synthesis-format-contract. The proposed corpus strengthens testing but does not define a materially distinct externally observable failure.
Rejected as a process-traceability quality claim rather than a distinct, externally observable export failure with a direct material outcome.

output.audit_summary: Accepted nine materially distinct lenses covering export scope, content preservation, command routing, destination behavior, empty results, representation, ordering, source immutability, and incomplete artifacts. All twelve proposals were dispositioned; two were rejected as vague or overbroad and one was merged as duplicate test coverage.
